exam: 114年公務人員特種考試外交領事人員及外交行政人員考試、114年公務人員特種考試國際經濟商務人員考試、114年公務人員特種考試民航人員考試、114年公務人員特種考試原住民族考試
subject: 國際關係與近代外交史(以英文命題及作答)
classes: 外交領事人員類科英文組二

essays.text:
②請以藍、黑色鋼筆或原子筆在申論試卷上作答。The Israel-Hamas conflict since October 7, 2023, has had a profound impacton the Middle East and the world. If we believe the policies developed basedupon the Power Transition Theory are likely to solve the aforementionedconflict, then:
① Please identify the basic arguments of the Power Transition Theory. (10 points)
② Based upon the arguments above, provide a set of policy solutions that cansolve the aforementioned conflict efficiently. (10 points)In recent years, there has been a debate about whether or not the internationaleconomic order is returning to mercantilism. Such a phenomenon is quitedifferent from the development that the international economic order after theSecond World War focuses on liberalism :
①Please compare these two theories based upon the unit of analysis, thenature of the international economic relations, the attitudes toward trade,and state-market relations. (10 points)
② Please identify the main points of the aforementioned debate aboutreturning to mercantilism. (10 points)It is reported that Lenin once said that “The shortest way from Moscow toParis was through Beijing and Calcutta.” Therefore, after the establishmentof the Soviet Union, Moscow actively sought the favor of all walks of lifein China. What did Moscow do to Beijing to achieve this goal at that time?(17 points)Please elaborate the characteristics of the “Near Eastern Question” in the 19thcentury. (18 points)

mcq.q: Which of the following is the first country to reach a new trade deal with the United States after itsPresident’s announcement of“Reciprocal Tariff”on April 2, 2025?
opts: Japan.
United Kingdom.
Korea.
Canada.

mcq.q: Which of the following countries did NOT change its state leadership in 2025?
opts: The United States.
Korea.
France.
Germany.

mcq.q: Which of the following international agreements or initiatives is the United States not currentlyparticipating in?
opts: Global Maritime Fulcrum.
Australia-United Kingdom-United States.
Indo-Pacific Economic Framework.
Quadrilateral Security Dialogue.

mcq.q: Securing Our Future London Summit on March 2, 2025 concluded“a Four-Point Plan”for the future ofUkraine. Which of the following is NOT correct regarding this plan?
opts: Commitment to maintaining the flow of military aid to Ukraine while increasing economic pressureon Russia through sanctions and other measures.
Affirming that any lasting peace agreement must ensure the sovereignty and security of Ukraine, withUkraine being present at all peace negotiations.
Enhancing Ukraine’s defensive military capabilities following any peace deals to deter potentialfuture invasions.
Dispatching NATO Peacekeeping forces to Ukraine to implement the terms of any peace agreementand guarantee Ukraine’s security afterward.

mcq.q: Which of the following statement is NOT correct regarding the 1947“Truman Doctrine”?
opts: It became the main focus of the US foreign policy after WWII.
The US should lead democratic countries to contain infiltration of Soviet communist and vigorouslysupport the economic and military development of Europe.
It demanded the US congress to allocate budget to aid the Italian and Greek governments to preventthem from falling into communist hands.
It established a precedent for the US to aid anti-communist regimes around the world and to establishcontainment alliance against the Soviet Union.

mcq.q: Which of the following statements is NOT a Realist critique of Neo-liberal Institutionalism inInternational Relations?
opts: International institutions have no independent status; they merely reflect the distribution of powerand interests.

Under anarchy, even though international institutions possess monitoring and reciprocal mechanisms, theenforcement power of these institutions is too weak, which limits the extent of cooperation among states.
Neo-liberal Institutionalism overlooks the problem of “relative gains”; states may still refuse tocooperate if they realize that other countries gain more than they do.

Neo-liberal Institutionalism oversimplifies issues of international relations as problems of marketinformation and efficiency, neglecting the structural oppression and inequalities inherent in theinternational system.

mcq.q: Regarding the Global Cooperation and Training Framework (GCTF), which of the following statementsis NOT correct?
opts: In 2015, Taiwan and the United States signed a memorandum of understanding to establish the GlobalCooperation and Training Framework, aiming to expand Taiwan’s international space.
The GCTF has held international workshops on topics such as public health, law enforcementcooperation, women’s empowerment, cybersecurity, humanitarian assistance, and disaster relief.
Aside from the United States, Japan, Australia, and Canada are full partners of the GCTF.
The main purpose of the GCTF is to work with like-minded democratic countries to jointly contain theglobal expansion of authoritarianism.

mcq.q: Which of the following statements is NOT correct regarding“Sharp Power”?
opts: It takes advantage of the openness of democratic societies to spread disinformation and propaganda.
It involves coercive measures, using military attacks and invasions or economic incentives andsanctions, to compel compliance from other nations.
It aims to erode trust in democratic institutions, limit free speech, and distort public opinion.
It targets political elites, journalists, academics, and other influential individuals to gain support.

mcq.q: Which of the following is a member state to all of the following three multilateral institutions: AUKUS,QUAD, and Five Eyes?
opts: India.
Japan.
Canada.
Australia.

mcq.q: In 2023, the Japanese government proposed a new plan to promote the“Free and Open Indo-Pacific”(FOIP)vision. Which of the following items is NOT included among its main components?
opts: Establishing an Indo-Pacific environment that safeguards peace, upholds the principles of freedom,transparency, and the rule of law, and ensures that the weak will not yield to coercion by force.

Expanding international cooperation to enhance the resilience and sustainability of Indo-Pacificcountries in addressing challenges such as climate change, public health, disaster prevention andresponse, and cybersecurity.
Creating a military coordination mechanism to safeguard collective security in the Indo-Pacific regionand enhance the inter-operability of military systems of individual countries.
Extending the scope of security from the maritime domain to include the airspace, ensuring the safetyand stability of the entire Indo-Pacific public domain.

mcq.q: After the end of the Crimean War in 1856, the great powers called upon the Paris Peace Conference.Which of the following statement is incorrect?
opts: Free navigation of the Danube River.
Neutralization of the Black Sea; Warships shall not freely pass through the Two Straits.
Turkey was admitted to the European community.
The goods from neutralized countries carried on enemy’s ships may be captured and confiscated.

mcq.q: In September 1899, the U.S. Secretary of State John Hay instructed American ambassadors to UnitedKingdom, Germany, Japan and Russia, to seek host country’s endorsement of the“Open Door Policy ofChina.”Which country showed its indifference toward John Hay’s proposal?
opts: Russia.
The United Kingdom.
Japan.
Germany.

mcq.q: Which of the following statement about the Opium War is correct?
opts: The British government attached great importance to business issues; thus, as early as the Qianglongperiod of the Qing Dynasty, Amherst was dispatched to negotiate with the Chinese government.

Due to the prevalence of liberal trade theories, during the Daoguang period of the Qing Dynasty, theBritish government abolished the East India Company’s trade privileges with China, and began to allowBritish businessmen to trade with China.
Lin Zexu banned smoking in Guangzhou at a time when the British Liberal Party was in power andPrime Minister Palmerston decided to send troops to China.
The consequence of the Opium War was the signing of the Sino-British treaty of Beijing in 1842.

mcq.q: Which of the following statement is true about the Sino-French Vietnam War in the late Qing Dynasty?
opts: During the Tongzhi period of the Qing Dynasty, the French colonists actually controlled south-central Vietnam.
The ministers of the Qing Dynasty were divided into two factions: peace and war. Li Hongzhangactively advocated war.
In 1884, the French fleet shelled Keelung and blocked Taiwan. At that time, Shen Baozhen was incharge of Taiwan’s military affairs.
In 1885, Liu Yongfu’s troops, the Black Flag Army, won consecutive victories at Zhennangquan inGuangxi and Lang Mountain in northern Vietnam.

mcq.q: Which of the following statement regarding the Boxer Rebellion and the Eight-Power Allied Forces is true?
opts: The Boxers originated from the White Lotus Sect and was first popular in Henan.
The activities initiated by the Boxers caused protests from the Germans, so the Qing court sent YuanShikai to the south to suppress these activities.
After the Eight-Power Allied Forces dispatched troops, they jointly elected the Russian general Alfredvon Waldersee as the commander-in-chief of the coalition forces.
After the Eight-Power Allied Forces occupied Beijing, the governors of the southeastern provincesadvocated a self-protection movement led by Zeng Guofan.

mcq.q: China was defeated in the First Opium War, as a consequence, China and the United Kingdom signed theTreaty of Nanjing in August 1842. Which of the following ports was NOT included in their agreementregarding the“Five Ports Trading”?
opts: Wenzhou.
Guangzhou.
Xiamen.
Ningbo.

mcq.q: Historians regarded the term “Napoleon War”as Bonaparte Napoleon led the First Empire of France infighting against the anti-Napoleon coalition. How did Napoleon call his strategic framework against theUnited Kingdom?
opts: European Continent System.
Paris System.
Continental System.
North Sea System.

mcq.q: What was the cause that led to the breakout of Japan-Russo War in 1904?
opts: Ownership of the Dongqing Railway.
Struggle over lease rights of Dalian and Lushun.
Protection of overseas Japanese in Manchuria.
Competition over the sphere of influence on Korea.

mcq.q: Japan and Russia, put aside their hatred caused by the 1904 Japan-Russo war, signed two secret treatiesin July 1907 and June 1910. Which of the following consequences was NOT included?
opts: The partition of sphere of influence on Manchuria between Japan and Russia.
Reached a consensus on U.S.“Open Door Policy of China.”
Russia began to instigate the independence of Outer Mongolia.
Japan’s annexation of Korea.

mcq.q: The Industrial Revolution started from the United Kingdom. Which country came next?
opts: The Netherlands.
France.
Spain.
Belgium.
